result.title: Click and Count: Multimodal Prototype Adaptation for Class-Agnostic Object Counting
result.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2027 IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence (IEEE SSCI 2027). Code: https://github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count
result.summary: We propose a multimodal, class-agnostic, density-based object counting framework that specifies the object of interest through visual exemplars, a text description, or both, within a single iterative refinement pipeline. Existing counters typically fall into two groups: methods that fuse two modalities, a hand-drawn bounding box and a text description, to specify the target object, and single-modality methods that rely on either a box exemplar or text alone. A few recent methods replace the box with a point or click. We expand a single click into a precise object mask via a frozen visual-prompt segmentation model, feeding an iterative prototype-refinement process that also fuses a text description at every refinement step. We make two contributions: first, a click-derived exemplar extraction module that removes the bounding-box requirement of prior exemplar-based counters; second, a per-step text-fusion mechanism that combines visual and textual prompts throughout refinement. Combined with text guidance, our model achieves state-of-the-art counting accuracy, outperforming prior click-based counting methods across all metrics and surpassing the box-exemplar base architecture in mean absolute error. The code is available at github.com/ameniifi/Click-and-Count.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向类别无关目标计数的多模态密度框架：以冻结分割模型把单次点击扩展为精确目标掩码，再在迭代的原型细化过程中每一步融合文本描述，从而摆脱对手绘边界框的依赖，并在计数精度上优于既有点击式方法。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「点击→掩码→逐步原型细化」的迭代状态更新与逐步骤多模态融合，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据指定与 latent 状态反复修正提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作面向计数这一密集预测任务，未涉及显式推理状态或答案生成，迁移性需阅读原文确认。
